title: Transformations & Angle Relationships
preview: Translations, reflections, rotations, dilations, similarity, and angle relationships from parallel lines cut by a transversal.
description: Students apply rigid motions and dilations on the coordinate plane, recognise congruence and similarity, and reason about angle relationships in figures.

sections.label: 9-1 Translations, Reflections & Rotations
sections.description: Apply rigid motions on the coordinate plane; describe results in coordinate notation.

sections.label: 9-2 Dilations & Similarity
sections.description: Apply dilations from the origin; use similarity to find unknown lengths.

sections.label: 9-3 Angle Relationships in Triangles
sections.description: Interior angle sum, exterior-angle theorem, isoceles base angles.

sections.label: 9-4 Parallel Lines Cut by a Transversal
sections.description: Corresponding, alternate, and co-interior angle relationships.
